So she nurtures life AND maintains harmony. Thus the condition for not protecting all is satisfied → therefore Arlette does NOT protect all. Then from added rule: If she does not protect all, then she cannot guide all. So she cannot guide all. Therefore, Arlette is omnipresent but cannot guide all. Hence the implication 'If omnipresent, then can guide all' is false.
